content: {"episode_id":"ep-05026","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring) for this episode. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent palpitations and a history of atrial fibrillation (I48.91, R00.2), raising concern for intermittent arrhythmia recurrence. Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73), the note states that continuous monitoring is indicated to detect potential embolic sources or rhythm disturbances that may have been missed on standard ECG. On these documented grounds we request reconsideration of the denied service and the outstanding balance of 549.76."}
